releaseNotes.summary: v0.9.6-beta - ADMIN EHANCEMENTS: errors views, log archiving & restoration, logs deletion controls, RAG IMPROVEMENTS AND MORE...
changes: added 3 new admin endpoints, `/errors`, `/errors/stream`, and `/log-archives`
added 1 new public endpoint `/api/session` for retrieving the current session information
added 7 new controls for admin including: `delete-logs`, `delete-lines`, `delete-last`, `delete-line`, `rotate-logs`, `restore-log` and `reset-telemetry`
added 3 new admin pages for viewing server events, errors, and logs, and split `admin.css` into seperate files for each page
added 2 new dependencies `marked` and `dompurify` for rendering markdown in the admin pages
added 3 new tools: `test`, `update`, `all`.
added new error view that allows to see all errors, their stack, timestamp, and file of origin
added new log archive view that allows to see all backups, their timestamps, lines, bytes, and able to restore/switch between backups
added new logs controls that allows to delete logs from X to X, delete last X lines, delete a specific line
added a reset telemetry control that allows to reset the telemetry data
added descriptive friendly error messages for all errors
replaced custom markdown parser with `marked` and `dompurify` for better security and performance
removed children=[] from routes.js and any dependencies on it
updated docs with up to date information
improved RAG route extraction to detect routes defined through conditional path checks, including exact matches, prefixes, and array-based path matching
RAG: improved HTTP method inference for conditionally handled routes, including GET and POST methods
RAG: fixed duplicate route entries in the route parser by merging matching routes and their inferred methods
fixed `/api/routes` to return accurate route information, including supported HTTP methods, match types, source files, and line numbers
RAG: expanded route discovery to include endpoints defined outside `server/api/`, such as `/webhook` and `/admin/login`
added automated tests for `code-parser.js` to verify route extraction, HTTP method inference, and route deduplication
added thinking (which shows the summary of tools used, tool responses and reasoning) and time elapsed to the AI activity view
switched model from `openrouter/free` to `openai/gpt-6-luna` for better performance and reliability
moved `csrfToken` from `/api/admin/summary` too `/api/session` for better security and tells information about the current client authorisation
fixed head not showing csrftoken in the meta tag
deduplicated the `getReleaseInfo` function to avoid redundant version info
added/revised all docs to reflect the latest changes, including new endpoints, admin controls, and RAG improvements
updated README.md with new features, endpoints, and admin controls

scripts.start: npm run build && npm run lint && concurrently --names "BOT,SERVER" "npm run bot" "node server/server.js"
scripts.build:preview: vite build --config server/client/vite.config.mjs && vite preview --open --config server/client/vite.config.mjs
scripts.test: node --test "test/**/*.test.js" && npm run validate-manifest && npm run validate-commands && npm run lint
scripts.update: npm run generate-manifest && npm run release
scripts.all: npm run test && npm run update && npm start
